name: smwgraphics-alternate-redrawn-muncher
title: Alternate Redrawn Muncher
description:
Alternate Redrawn graphics for the Muncher/Black Piranha Plant pseudo-enemy, now looking actually black to fit-in its more modern name.

While it's meant to replace the original Muncher's graphics, files for the plants having four animation frames like in Super Mario Bros 3 are also included.

Credit's not needed but very much appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-alternative-redrawn-pidgit-bill
title: Alternative Redrawn Pidgit Bill
description:
Alternative redrawn graphics for SMW Redrawn's Pidgit Bill, which replaces vanilla Bullet Bill's graphics after all 96 exits have been found.

This version now includes graphics for the vertical and diagonal Bullet Bills, as well exanimation data for both based on how fast the user wants the Pidgits to flap their wings.

Give credit to me, SF - The Dark Warrior, and Frattari Gaspar if used.

name: smwgraphics-bandr-s-grassland
title: bandr's Grassland
description:
My first ever ExGFX. (at least, that i post.)

I don't care about credits, honestly. But, it would be nice if you would just go ahead and credit me.

Inspired by Tob's "Super Mario World Styled Faithful Athletic Grassland".

name: smwgraphics-brambles
title: Brambles
description:
Brambles I made for my QLDC 2021 level, Curse of the Keys. They're GBA/DS styled-ish and blend well with my other tilesets. Since they only take 1 slot I would suggest mixing them with the wood/bridge tiles from my Radished Cliffside set.

Note that the sloped tiles are set to act like normal slopes (the upside-down ones as tileset-specifics). They need some kind of patch (Like This UberASM) or custom block to achieve the effect.

name: smwgraphics-burnt-mario
title: Burnt Mario
description:
This is an expanded version of the castle #5 cutscene sprites in the original game. This also contains overworld sprites for burnt Mario.

If you're going to use please be sure to give credit.

name: smwgraphics-chef-chuck
title: Chef Chuck
description:
A chef skin for the various Chuck sprites. Looks oddly similar to Chef Kawasaki from the Kirby series. To fix the shoulder, please apply this tweak.

Made by No Body the Dragon.

Original graphic replacements for the following sprites:
  • SMB2 Shyguy + Giant Shyguy
  • SMB2 Snifit + Giant Snifit
  • Beezo + Giant Beezo
  • Tweeter + Giant Tweeter

May or may not be compatible with other sprite adaptations of these enemies.

name: smwgraphics-doraemon
title: Doraemon 3: Nobita to Toki no Hougyoku - Factory (Bonus Room)
description:
The underwater marine life, seen in one of the rooms of the Ancient Ruins, from Doraemon 3 for the Super Famicom. The source material uses wave HDMA, but maybe you can use parallax scrolling to move the fishes.

Since it is a really tall background, it uses one of the expanded horizontal level modes. To change it, click in the Mario head icon in Lunar Magic and put Horizontal Level Mode to the value you'd like.

A good fit for underwater or bonus levels.

description:
The 2nd dungeon's tasty BG and FG from DoReMi Fantasy, you can use this for a sweets-themed stage (obviously), or you could just use the starry night sky BG for something else (even if I don't know how to animate palettes yet, since in the original game the BG palette was animated). I had to compress 4 of the original game's palettes used for this FG tileset into 1, including the fact that I had to paint the moving ledge platform red.
For better performance with the ledge hole sprite, use this patch.

versions.title: DoReMi Fantasy: Milon no DokiDoki Daibouken - Guardian's Lair (World 2)

name: smwgraphics-forest-jungle
title: Forest / Jungle
description:
Foreground started earlier on in the year as a request in The Rip Lair, finished as of today thanks to the assistance of Moltz (conversions to .bin, drawing of the climbable vines, decor grass on dirt fill, bush decor, flowers for bushes, brambles, non-slanted vines on logs is his contributions. Everything else is my own contribution).

Inspired by 2 entries of the Magical Quest Starring Mickey Mouse, with a hint of Kirby's Adventure and SMB2USA/DDP.

Primarily meant to be used with Redrawn-styled sprite assets as it was designed for that, but it can be used for other styles if you want.

Give credit to me and Moltz if you use it for your SMW hack/fangame projects.

name: smwgraphics-ganbare-goemon
title: Ganbare Goemon 2: Kiteretsu Shougun Magginesu - Susonogawa River
description:
The landscape seen during the second Impact demolition sequence, from Ganbare Goemon 2: Kiteretsu Shougun Magginesu. It depicts another view of Mt. Fuji, this time, directly from the Susonogawa River, where the player must destroy various enemy troops bases and fight another giant robot.

The water is palette animated. It benefits a lot from parallax scrolling in certain parts.

You can extend the river easily, if you don't like the perspective of the background.

A good fit for mountain or forest themed levels.

name: smwgraphics-hatsune-miku
title: Hatsune Miku
description:
“I can see at the end of the horizon — HATSUNE MIKU?!”

You heard that right — the most famous Vocaloid of all has arrived to Super Mario World! Featuring all of the poses included in the game, as well as for the overworld. In addition, it has several color schemes, such as Player 2 Miku having Akita Neru's palette, and Fire Miku palettes being based on Sakura and Snow Miku color schemes.

Please note that, due to the way SMW graphics limitations work, all of her graphics are HEAVILY EDITED to compensate with player graphics (and color palette even!) limitations. A future update will include support for 32x32 Tilemap Patch, which allows more dynamic movements and poses.

Credit goes to Kryz70phoro for making the graphics (You can check out the spritesheet here!) and ported by yours truly for ROM hacking usage.

name: smwgraphics-mushrooms
title: Mushrooms 2026
description:
A background with large mushroom platforms which would go well especially in grassland levels. It is a revamped version of this submission, 18 years forward, with a glossy, more refined art style, higher tile usage, three different variations and featuring both a Layer 2 and a Layer 3 part. Since the latter takes up the entire screen, if you intend to use it it is expected that you either replace the Layer 3 status bar with a sprite alternative (e.g. 1, 2, 3) or disable it entirely (1, 2).

Credit is optional, but appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-porcupos
title: Redrawn Styled Porcupos
description:
Redrawn style graphics that reskin SMW Spiny into Super Mario Bros 2's Porcupo (the hedgehogs-looking dudes).

Alternate variations are included based on whether the user wants the enemy's spikes to look brighter or darker, and also if they should use either Palette 9 or any other color. By default, A custom Palette 9 and C are included.

Credit's not required but very much appreciated.

name: smwgraphics-sonic-mania-stardust-speedway-zone-act
title: Sonic Mania - Stardust Speedway Zone (Act 1)
description:
Here's the BG and FG of Stardust Speedway Zone, I had to take some creative liberties with the Layer 3 BG because I don't think I can fit that many tiles in one file, and I don't want to sacrifice the global LG storage for this. I had to reduce the amount of colors in the palettes of the FG and the L3 BG, also, I had to reshade some of the FG tiles to appear more "smooth" to give off the illusion that it has more color, like in the original tileset.

A huge thank you to Random Talking Bush from the TSR moderation team for letting me and everyone else use this BG and FG tileset, go check out their original submission and their profile, and make sure to credit them for originally ripping these assets for everyone to use!

NOTICE: I'd highly recommend to apply a patch to remove the layer 3 statusbar to make space for layer 3 BG's

If you want to lower the background, you must edit the parallax tables at the end of the asm file.

A good fit for climatic boss battles or sky levels.

description:
Whisper The Wolf...But in SMW Let´s Go >:D. Made by me :).
The Zip File includes:
GFX32 (Player)
GFX28 (Name)
GFX10 (Overworld Player)
GFX00 (Some Player Tiles)

Also includes optional GFX:
GFX22
GFX24 (Both removes blushing frames from the vanilla ending)

Funny Thing: Like i did with Tangle & Rayman, Second Player it´s a Silver Color Reference (not at all), again, to mimic "Green Mario". (Because of the limited colors and some shared colors between P1 & P2, P2 looks a little weird)
